item.description: We're excited to introduce the new home for Konflux CI! This website is now your central hub for everything Konflux — documentation, architecture details, getting started guides, and community resources.
item.content:encoded:
We're excited to introduce the new home for Konflux CI! This website is now your central hub for everything Konflux — documentation, architecture details, getting started guides, and community resources.

A Fresh Start​

After careful planning and development, we've launched this new website to provide a better experience for the Konflux community. Whether you're a first-time visitor or a long-time contributor, you'll find everything you need in one place.

What You'll Find Here​

Documentation​

Our comprehensive documentation covers everything from initial setup to advanced configurations. Head over to the documentation to explore guides, API references, and best practices.

Architecture & Design​

Want to understand how Konflux works under the hood? We've included detailed architecture information and design decisions that power the platform.

Getting Started​

New to Konflux? Check out our Getting Started guide for a step-by-step walkthrough that will have you up and running quickly.

Community & Contributions​

Konflux is an open source project, and we welcome contributions from the community. Stay tuned for more resources on how to get involved.

What's Next​

This is just the beginning. We'll be regularly updating this site with new content, tutorials, and resources. Keep an eye on this blog for announcements, updates, and insights from the Konflux team.

We're glad you're here. Welcome home!

— The Konflux Team
